method: Final production only: per-rank chi=sum G-G[0]+N/L^2; W2=Wx2+Wy2. Separate histogram and diagonal-sample count weights. Delete-one-rank jackknife sqrt((R-1)/R sum((theta_minus_rank-mean_loo)^2)).
limitations: Requires independent equilibrated rank streams. Configured thermalization threshold alone is not proof of equilibration.
Only final production rank data: these errors must not be attached to the pooled three-production mean.
No scalar time series or blocking plateau available.
Only parameters, measurements and sweep count read; no configuration arrays.
